decision_standard: Authentic recorded photographs and other real observations are real data. Measured outputs of actually executed models trained on real data, including generative models, may be scientifically valid when labeled accurately and evaluated against authentic observations. Fabricated observations, metrics, or results are prohibited.

require_provenance_review.reason: Figure generator presence alone does not prove real dataset backing for its charts.
Requires traceability for every empirical chart; code presence alone is insufficient.

require_provenance_review.unit: Chapter 6 NEU real-photo versus GAN-output domain comparison
require_provenance_review.reason: Legitimate comparative experiment in principle. Verify NGDC/NEU source photograph provenance, GAN training records, generated-output identity, genuine held-out test observations, and exact metric generation. Do not call GAN output a real photograph.

require_provenance_review.unit: Chapter 6 real NEU and photographic texture comparison
require_provenance_review.reason: Real NEU steel-defect photographs and skimage texture photographs are authentic observations. Synthetic GAN outputs constitute a transparently labeled experimental arm, not fabricated experimental results. Evaluate execution/provenance before certification.

rules_for_all_chapters: Empirical data must be authentic real-world recorded observations, cited and provenance-checked.
Real-data model predictions and measured metrics must come from actual code execution, not hand-specified vectors.

Generated images from a trained model may be scientifically evaluated as generated outputs; they must not be passed off as captured real photographs. Authentic real photographs remain valid scientific data.
Every figure/table is linked to committed code, named source dataset, split counts, actual raw metrics/predictions, and hash or verifiable GitHub asset.
No unit can be certified merely because its code compiles or a source file exists.
Explanatory architecture drawings are not experimental figures and must not contain fabricated numerical results.
current_global_status: NOT CERTIFIED; named experimental units remain missing or unverified.
